nodes.bdb: Merab = "increase" the eldest daughter of king Saul; promised to David but given instead to Adriel the Meholathite; mother of 5 children

nodes.g: Adriel = "flock of God" son of Barzillai, and the man to whom Saul gave his daughter…
Meholathite = Mehola "of dancing" an inhabitant of a place evidently named 'Meholah'
